correctness.rationale: The exact d=1 statistic is the median-comparison U-statistic. Explicit rational integration gives positive contrasts 1/250 and 45549381047/5150145000000; a three-interval positive Bernstein certificate proves the quartic CDF strictly increasing. Two-sample U-statistic strong laws give the negative alternative limit. Under the null the first projections are opposites with variance 17/35, producing a positive chi-square rejection scale. The exact finite-null mean follows from complete 0/1/2 shared-index contractions, not sample enumeration. The bundled standard-library exact rational checker passes 40 assertions/identities.

originality.rationale: The first-public 2021 preprint and the 2023 full journal text provide the kernel, general mean-integral and U-statistic framework; the supplementary mathematical proofs address these generalities, not an existence certificate for same-sign nonzero contrasts under a strictly positive smooth alternative. The present signed negative population limit, exact quartic certificate and zero-power consequence are not stated there. A related 2019 binary expansion independence test is not an identical two-sample negative-product statistic. Targeted semantic-result and literature searches found no directly dominating theorem. This is evidence of noncoverage, not proof of priority.
residual_risks: Historical priority is not independently verified; unindexed earlier or later studies may state an equivalent sign-reversal argument.
Zhang (2019) was checked at the abstract level only; it concerns a different testing construction.

value.rationale: Nonzero measured population asymmetries can both be positive while the published right-tail negative product is strictly negative, so a detectable smooth alternative has asymptotic rejection probability zero. This is a substantive aggregation/consistency boundary, stronger than exhibiting an alternative on which both cell signals vanish. The exact null scale and finite mean clarify calibration; no higher-depth or alternate-test claim is made.
